title.narrative: Catalysing Market Prospects for Horticulture Smallholder Farmers and Small and Medium Enterprises in Rwanda

description.narrative: The action will contribute to; increased household incomes of smallholder horticultural producers the action will organize smallholder farmers into common interest produce groups and commercial zones for collective access to business development services and market linkage. Improved global competitiveness, reliability and profitability of Rwandan horticultural value chains by building the capacity of smallholder farmers on standard operating procedures and internal quality control for compliance with various market requirement. Horticulture value chain financing, through capacity building on appropriate agri-financing solutions to complement existing saving and loaning schemes established through Self- Help Groups and facilitating linkage with financial institutions through trade fairs and exhibitions to provide information to smallholders on available financial products. Upgrading of horticultural value chains to generate more employment opportunities, through promotion of intensive production of the selected value chains generating employment opportunities along production, harvesting, post-harvest handling and marketing.
